title: Fix React minified error #185 causing runtime failure

requirements.text: Investigate and resolve React minified error #185 in the deployed application, which typically indicates a hydration mismatch, invalid DOM nesting, or rendering inconsistency between server and client

quotes: Minified React error #185; visit https://react.dev/errors/185 for the full message or use the non-minified dev environment for full errors and additional helpful warnings.

acceptanceCriteria: React error #185 no longer appears in browser console after deployment
Application loads and renders without runtime errors
All pages and components display correctly without hydration warnings

requirements.text: Check Dashboard.tsx, Chat.tsx, Settings.tsx, and Layout.tsx for conditional rendering logic that may cause hydration mismatches between initial render and subsequent renders
acceptanceCriteria: Conditional rendering based on authentication state uses consistent logic
No components render different content on client vs server hydration
Loading states are properly managed to prevent render mismatches

requirements.text: Verify all React hooks (useState, useEffect, useQuery) in role-based widget rendering on Dashboard.tsx do not cause rendering conflicts or stale closure issues
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard role-based widget conditional rendering works without errors
React hooks have correct dependency arrays
No infinite render loops or state update conflicts

requirements.text: Review ProfileSetupModal and ChatWidget components for improper portal usage, modal rendering, or floating element positioning that could cause DOM nesting violations
acceptanceCriteria: Modals and floating widgets render in correct DOM hierarchy
No portals create invalid parent-child relationships
Draggable chat widget positioning does not violate DOM constraints

requirements.text: Enable non-minified development build or add source maps to get the full React error message and stack trace for debugging error #185
acceptanceCriteria: Full error message and component stack trace are visible
Exact component and line number causing error #185 is identified
Development build successfully reveals root cause

requirements.text: Test the application end-to-end after fixes to ensure error #185 is completely resolved and no new React errors are introduced
acceptanceCriteria: Application deploys successfully without build errors
All pages load without React runtime errors
Role selection, dashboard widgets, and chat functionality work correctly
Browser console shows no React errors or warnings

constraints: Do not change the backend Motoko code as this is a frontend React rendering error
Preserve all existing component functionality while fixing DOM structure
Maintain role-based conditional rendering logic for parent and child widgets
nonGoals: Changing application styling or visual design
Modifying backend data structures or API endpoints
